svg.title: Codec I/O follows a state machine
svg.desc: Accepting an input does not promise one immediately available output. Bottom boxes are cases, not one sequence. Sleeping alone does not resolve EAGAIN.

Accepting an input does not promise one immediately available output.
Bottom boxes are cases, not one sequence. Sleeping alone does not resolve EAGAIN.
